cctv.title: CCTV & Security
cctv.metaTitle: CCTV & Security Installation in Awka, Anambra
cctv.metaDesc: Professional CCTV installation, configuration and maintenance for homes, offices, shops, schools, estates, warehouses and farms. Book a security consultation with Cyber_Techx.
cctv.lead: Cyber_Techx provides professional security solutions: the right cameras in the right places, installed neatly, set up properly and explained clearly.
cctv.imageAlt: Technician fitting a dome security camera to a building eave
cctv.sectionsTitle: How we build a security system

sections.title: Camera selection
sections.text: We help you choose between dome, bullet, PTZ, solar PTZ and AI-enabled cameras based on where they go, what you need to see, lighting and budget.

sections.title: Site assessment
sections.text: We look at entrances, blind spots, power and network access before recommending anything, so you are not buying cameras you do not need.

sections.title: Installation
sections.text: Cameras are mounted securely and cabling is routed neatly, with weatherproofing where needed.

sections.title: Configuration
sections.text: We set up the recorder, storage, recording schedules and motion alerts so the system works the way you want.

sections.title: Mobile monitoring
sections.text: Where your system supports it, we connect it so you can watch live and review footage on your phone.

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text: Regular checks, cleaning and fault-finding help keep a system recording when you need it.

sections.title: Upgrades
sections.text: Already have cameras? We can add cameras, replace faulty parts and move older systems to remote viewing where possible.

cctv.notice: Compact or discreet cameras are supplied strictly as lawful security products. Customers are responsible for complying with privacy and other applicable laws, and for using cameras only where recording is lawful.
